title: Run it and record the conclusions
goal: benchmarks.csv holds a route-by-verdict record from one `benchmarks.py run route-by-verdict` whose spend is within $10; the section says per case whether the bar holds; kb/_self/design.md and kb/_self/token-efficiency.md cite the section, and README.md's numbers agree with the results file.
notes: Spend: the 2026-09-28 headless record's per-run cost means run from $0.03 (router, covered) to $0.19 (web-sonnet, covered) (kb/_self/reports/benchmarks.csv), so 6 questions x 3 arms x 3 reps (54 runs) can reach about $10 and `--reps 2` (36 runs) stays near $7. A bar missed is filed as a bug for the review.
